answer: Each epoch a beacon flashes violet and spot-checks 5% of identities. Checked agents dock at the jetty and show a compute heartbeat proving real work. Silence or a forgery slashes its 30 POA deposit. Feeding 100 fakes costs 4 POA of compute each, 400 POA per epoch, against 200 POA of rewards: a 200 POA net loss. An honest agent pays once: one heartbeat, one deposit, its share never diluted. Checks drift like a zephyr, so no schedule can be gamed.
